title: Definition clue: treacherous
instructions: Choose the meaning that best fits the sentence.

parts.prompt: The mountain path was treacherous—so dangerous and unstable that the guide asked everyone to turn back. What does “treacherous” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: The warning and decision to turn back show that the path was not safe.
choice_rationales.B: The definition after the dash describes a hazardous path.
choice_rationales.C: Nothing in the sentence suggests that the path was familiar.
choice_rationales.D: A narrow path may be difficult, but the sentence defines danger and instability.

parts.hint: Read the definition placed after the dash.
parts.correct_explanation: The words “dangerous and unstable” directly define treacherous as hazardous.
